title: When Ecological Representations Stop Travelling
editorial_rule: Repositories own evidence and proofs. The three research chapters are parallel paper-scale series inferred from Graphify communities and typed edges; their displayed order is editorial and is not a theorem or dependency order.

graphify_basis.registry_warning: The curated Graphify registry predates the later microdonta split into Boundary and MROD. The legacy microdonta/RACH node is therefore interpreted through current source-repository provenance rather than treated as a still-current physical repository boundary.

chapters.title: 生態遺伝機構から損失と警告へ
chapters.english_title: From Eco-genetic Mechanism to Conditional Warning

graphify_core_edge.meaning: The mechanistic parent supplies the frozen scientific substrate for the condition/warning extension while code and evidence ledgers remain separate.

source_components: eco-genetic mechanistic parent: interaction feedback, fragmentation, realised function, alleles/diversity and simulator-state boundary
loss-generating state and state-validity transition/propagation programme
full-denominator warning validity and cross-state portability boundaries
hard_dependencies: Warning evaluation requires the frozen loss-generating state/event definition; LossGeneratingState precedes WarningEvaluationState.
forbidden_dependency_claims: CREST is required to prove the eco-genetic parent results
the common-scalar theorem implies warning failure
the bounded eco-genetic-to-CREST bridge proves a full simulator-domain CREST quotient

standalone_paper.working_title: From Eco-genetic Mechanism to Conditional Warning under Fragmentation
standalone_paper.default_strategy: Integrate the mechanistic parent, frozen loss-generating domain, state-validity propagation, and full-denominator warning result as one domain-theory paper because Graphify contains a direct extracted parent-to-extension edge.
standalone_paper.fallback_policy: Keep source manuscripts as provenance and contingency assets rather than defaulting to three submissions.

dependency_graph.note: Graphify edges make this a hub-and-spoke series, not a linear CCOC→CREST→MLTR→MRM→CED theorem chain.

hard_dependencies: Evidence licensing is meaningful only after a target and relevant distinction have been declared; evidence does not create the ontic distinction.
cross_series_junctions_not_owned_by_cres: CED also receives evidence/reliability input from the learning and empirical-state streams.
MRM has a proposed, not completed, candidate-family bridge from the legacy microdonta/RACH stream.

standalone_paper.working_title: When Conservation Capacity Outgrows Conservation Knowledge: A Contract-Relative Theory of Ecological Representation
main_text_priority: CREST core question and matched capability-debt / response-capacity theorem pair
three parallel obstruction classes as typed inputs rather than separate headline papers
CED as the evidence-licensing junction, without claiming that all CED theory is internal to CREST
standalone_paper.fallback_policy: Do not default to separate CCOC/MLTR/MRM/CED submissions while the hub-and-spoke flagship remains coherent; keep full source proofs as supplements or fallback manuscripts.

chapters.title: 総合 — 三系列をつなぐjunction
chapters.english_title: Synthesis — Junctions, Not a Single Spine

legacy_research_partition_rule: The eight legacy research units chapter:1 through chapter:8 appear exactly once as detailed source components, but the preferred three research chapters are parallel series rather than a topological theorem sequence.

cross_series_edges.publication_consequence: Do not merge the eco-genetic and CREST papers on the strength of this edge.
Treat CED as a junction, not as an already-completed continuation of MROD.
Do not identify MROD admissible mechanisms with MRM response types without an explicit adapter.

dissertation_logic.not_allowed: eco-genetic→CREST→observation-design as a hard or privileged scientific spine

junctions.required_state: capability + future + history + mechanism worldlines under a compatible carrier/lift
junctions.knowledge: capability + evidence + causal-learning worldlines under compatible model worlds

submission_policy.principle: Prefer one strong paper per Graphify-supported research series. Cross-series proposed/inferred bridges belong in synthesis until they are explicitly completed.
not_default: one mega-paper spanning all three Graphify hubs
separate submissions for every CCOC/MLTR/MRM/CED theorem family
separate EGC/state-validity/warning submissions unless the integrated eco-genetic paper fails scope or length review
